scope.metric: shattering dimensionality only; CCGP omitted by design

solver.objective: mean logistic loss + 0.5 * lambda * mean-over-heads squared weight norm; bias unpenalised
solver.optimizer: full-batch L-BFGS with strong Wolfe line search
solver.convergence: relative training-objective change below 1e-3 over ten accepted L-BFGS iterations
solver.l2_selection: inner item-disjoint main-effect held-out logistic loss; largest lambda >= 1e-5 within 1e-2 nats/example of optimum; edge selections expand the grid

inner_validation_l2_selection.fallback_rule: Maximum predeclared grid expansion reached; retained the largest eligible candidate and flagged this selection as an edge fallback.

scaling_decision.metric: paired within-seed sae - rand_exp two-way-XOR shattering dimensionality

comparison_rule.dense_diagnostic: every resid and sae_recon SD family mean changes by <= 0.010

scaling_decision.wording: The paired estimates differ or at least one remains imprecise; L2 prior geometry prevents adjudication by this probe family.
